label: Form
description: A contact, sign-up or order form. Messages are kept in Content > Forms and can be sent to your email.

fields.label: Form name
fields.help: Shown in Content > Forms, to tell forms apart.

fields.label: Choices, one per line
fields.help: For the select and radio types.

fields.label: Send each message to this email
fields.help: Empty: the email in Settings > Contact. Leave both empty to only keep messages in Content > Forms.

fields.label: After sending, go to this page
fields.help: Empty: stay on the page and show the message.

fields.label: Consent note under the button
fields.help: For example: By sending this form you agree to our privacy policy.
